headline: Ravens stun Cowboys in final seconds as Loop gains redemption
summary: Lamar Jackson, Tyler Loop and the Ravens delivered one of the most remarkable last-second victories in recent NFL history Sunday, thanks to a late fourth-quarter decision made by the Cowboys.

headline: Raiders' Brock Bowers shines in return from knee procedure
summary: Brock Bowers showed no rust in his regular-season debut Sunday after undergoing a meniscus procedure, finishing with 10 catches for 116 yards and a TD.

headline: Kirk Cousins passes for 3 TDs and the unbeaten Raiders come back to top the Saints 35-27
summary: — It took the Las Vegas Raiders an entire season to accumulate three victories in 2025.

headline: Saints again on losing end of controversial fumble ruling
summary: The Saints walked away from Sunday's loss to the Raiders just as confused about the application of the quarterback fumble rules as they were in Week 1.

headline: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield has dislocated thumb, will undergo MRI
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated right thumb in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, coach Todd Bowles said.
